title: Replace CDN links with GitHub Pages; add missing report; modernize dictionary
description:
## Summary

The legacy `rsacdn.link` CDN is being retired. This repo now publishes via **GitHub Pages** (enabled on `main`, root). This PR repoints the dictionary **and report** references to Pages URLs, and adds the report HTML that the CDN was serving but which was missing from this repo.

## Changes

- **Repoint links (milestone files):** the `census_dictionary` (6 references) and `acs-report` (2 references) now point to `https://rstudio.github.io/academy-pinr-census/assets/<name>.html` instead of `rsacdn.link`.
- **Add the missing report:** `assets/acs-report.html` was referenced via the CDN but not present in the repo. Added the self-contained rendered report (no external asset dependencies).
- **Modernize the dictionary source:** `assets/census_dictionary.qmd` used R Markdown `output: html_document`; converted to native Quarto `format: html` with the default **cosmo** theme and `embed-resources: true`.

## Verification

- `grep` confirms **no** `rsacdn`, `cerulean`, or `teachthis` references remain in any `.qmd` or `.html`.
- The existing `census_dictionary.html` is already self-contained and CDN-free (only in-content links to census.gov / walker-data remain).
- GitHub Pages enabled and building; live dictionary + report URLs return HTTP 200 (report goes live once merged to `main`).

> **Note:** `census_dictionary.html` was **not** re-rendered from source in this pass because the dictionary requires the `kableExtra` R package, which is not installed in this environment. The committed HTML is already self-contained and CDN-free, so it works on Pages as-is. To re-render from the modernized source, install `knitr`/`kableExtra` and run `quarto render assets/census_dictionary.qmd`.
